description: Defines type traits and utility templates for the absl::random_internal namespace, including type conversions, unsigned type mappings, and bit width calculations.

classes.name: is_widening_convertible
classes.description: Template class to determine if type A can be safely widened to type B.

classes.name: IsIntegral
classes.description: Type trait to check if a type is an integral type, including absl::int128 and absl::uint128.

classes.name: MakeUnsigned
classes.description: Template struct to convert a type to its unsigned equivalent.

classes.name: IsUnsigned
classes.description: Type trait to check if a type is unsigned, including specializations for 128-bit types.

classes.name: unsigned_bits
classes.description: Template struct to map a number of bits to the corresponding unsigned integer type.

classes.name: U256
classes.description: Struct representing a 256-bit wide integer as high and low 128-bit parts.

classes.name: make_unsigned_bits
classes.description: Template struct to get the unsigned type with a specified number of bits.

methods.name: BitWidth
methods.description: Calculates the bit width of a given value, with a workaround for int128 support.
